exit_criteria: A real project requirement is processed through the defined QA artifact chain with source grounding preserved.
Cross-artifact validation finds no unresolved blocking contradiction or fabricated project behavior.
A controlled requirement change produces a useful traceable regression-impact scope.
A Human QC reviewer completes the usability review and dispositions material findings.
The adoption-readiness gate is reviewed and approved with no unresolved blocking usability issue.
Pilot findings remain distinguishable from canonical framework semantics and shared knowledge.
